From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A roof terrace on the Protaras strip

Nubila RoofTop Restaurant and Bar sits at Protara 62, up the steps behind the dark blue entrance with the golden lettering. On the roof: tables under sun sails, a bar, and a kitchen that cooks steaks, fresh pasta and salads.

Open every evening from half past five until one at night.

What guests say
